summary.subject: Second review round: renaming a variable keeps the field of a shorthand entry or destructuring, { x } becoming { x: z }; a parameter of an exported function is renamed in the named arguments of every importing module, and an export is refused a name an importer already binds; a generic function passed as a value is recorded, so hover and definition reach it; a code action writes a type with the names the module has for it, declines a type with an unknown part, and adds a field after the last entry rather than inside a trailing comment; signature help offsets count UTF-16 units; an import shows the first error of any module it reaches, at any depth; a Bad token ends a statement for the recovering parser instead of being reported twice, errors are deduplicated in constant time, an unreadable interpolation spans its part, and ParseRecover's doc claims only that the strict error is among its own; types complete after the colon of a var and the = of a type declaration; a space triggers nothing; folding keeps a } else { in view; a doc comment's bracketed name becomes code only when it names a declaration, and other text is escaped for Markdown; the connection ending after shutdown exits 1 as spec/lsp.md says; a message body is capped at 256 MB; a formatting edit never splits a CRLF
